{{Quote|What we do, we do not do for gratitude, Adi Gallia. We do it in accordance to the principals ''[sic]'' of the Force&hellip;and for the peace of the Republic!|Even Piell|<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 4">[[Star Wars (1998) 16|''Star Wars'' (1998) 16]]</ref>}}
'''Even Piell''' was a long-lived [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A native of the war-torn [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]], he was taken from poverty and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] at a young age, proving to be a fierce warrior and talented [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]]. He became a Master and was given a long-term seat on the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], serving on the Council during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], the [[Yinchorri Uprising]], and the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]]. Piell also occasionally served with the [[Palace Guard (Lannik)|Palace Guard]] of his [[Species/Legends|species's]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]] and foiled an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on the prince&mdash;at the cost of one of his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Piell was part of a team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sent to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to conduct peace negotiations between the newest prince of Lannik, [[R'cardo Sooflie IX]], and the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]] revolutionaries, who wanted the fighting to stop. The negotiations proved fruitless, and several of Sooflie's guardsmen&mdash;[[Hutar Zash|one]] of whom Piell had once served alongside&mdash;attempted to assassinate the Jedi to win support for the Red Iaro. Piell managed to foil the attempt and later helped save Sooflie from an attempt on his life by the remaining Red Iaro members. During Piell's continuing service on the Council, the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Jax Pavan]] became his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner.

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], Piell was there to [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|fight]] the rising [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and he served in many other battles during the war. At one point, Piell and his [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], were [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|captured]] by the Confederacy for their discovery of the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. Although they and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] escaped from [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]], Piell was fatally wounded by an [[Anooba/Legends|anooba]]. Before [[Death/Legends|passing on]], Piell sent his half of the Nexus Route intelligence to the Jedi Council through Jedi Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Piell was [[Funeral of Even Piell/Legends|laid to rest]] on Lola Sayu, where his sacrifice could be remembered.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|When I took the Jedi oath, I pledged my hands to the laws of the Republic and my mind to the ways of the Force. But my heart will ever belong to my homeworld.|Even Piell|<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3">[[Star Wars (1998) 15|''Star Wars'' (1998) 15]]</ref>}}
A [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Even Piell was born into an impoverished family on the war-ravaged [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]] during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Like most of his generation, he was expected to live a life of deprivation and misery on a planet where continuous conflict was commonplace. However, Piell was discovered to be strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as an [[Youngling/Legends|infant]] and was taken away from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to undergo training at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Piell showed an aptitude for the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] and proved an able wielder of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> The Lannik Jedi constructed his own lightsaber and often used it in his duties as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]].<ref name="Power of the Jedi">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> He earned a reputation as a fierce and humorless warrior<ref name="DB" /> who would never back away from a fight,<ref name="Clone Card: Even Piell">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_evenpiell.jpg|text=Clone Card: Even Piell|nobackup=1}}</ref> eventually becoming a revered [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> After becoming a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] sometime prior to the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]],<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War 4">[[Star Wars (1998) 39|''Star Wars'' (1998) 39]]</ref> he was granted a long-term seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> alongside the likes of Masters [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]].<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War 4" /> He was also a scholar on the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]].<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] like [[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]] remembered Piell for his stories about the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] clashes with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior.<ref name="Hammer">{{InsiderCite|147|Hammer (short story)}}</ref>

===Jedi Master===
{{Quote|I could have erased this wound in a bacta tank, Zug. Or had my eye replaced with prosthetics. I did ''not''. I kept these scars to remind me: of the eight who fought in the throne room that day, six died. Only one being walked out. The other ''ran''.|Even Piell, to Myk'Chur Finux Zug|<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" />}}
Sometime during the last years of the Galactic Republic, Piell became one of select few Jedi to return to his planet of origin after being Knighted. He served with the Lannik royal [[Palace Guard (Lannik)|Palace Guard]], alongside fellow Lannik [[Hutar Zash]], protecting two generations of Lannik princes; though a Jedi and fiercely loyal to the Republic, he never forgot his roots and served loyally and diligently. The Lannik government were embroiled in a costly war with a group of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] known as the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]], who were opposed to the traditional ways of Lannik and wanted to rule the planet in their own, extremist way. Negotiations between the two groups&mdash;mediated by high-profile [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]]&mdash;proved fruitless, and in a desperate, suicidal attempt to gain a foothold in the war, seven members of the Red Iaro, led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Myk'chur Finux Zug]], stormed a meeting between the diplomats and Lannik's [[Prince/Legends|prince]] in the [[Lannik High Court]], holding them hostage.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" />

Piell fought off the revolutionaries, slaying six of them and saving the lives of the Lannik royalty and the Corellian diplomats. However, Zug was able to flee and continue his rebel activities.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" /> During the fighting, Piell lost his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and suffered many grievous wounds, which scarred his entire face. However, he refused to accept [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] therapy or a [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic replacement]] for his lost eye; to him, the scar represented honor, bravery, and reminded him of his prevailing against the immoral despite incredible odds.<ref name="Power of the Jedi" /> He carried it as a badge of pride,<ref name="DB" /> and he never forgot his efforts in keeping the peace on his homeworld.<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> Yet the Red Iaro continued their insurgent activities under Zug's command;<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 1">[[Star Wars (1998) 13|''Star Wars'' (1998) 13]]</ref> a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]], later accepted by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], was put on Piell and his fellow Council members' heads by the "[[Chosen One (Lannik)|Chosen One]]," the leader of a cult which hoped to increase terrorist activity on Lannik.<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>

[[File:EvenPiell-E1IG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Piell during a meeting of the Council]]
The Corellian diplomats' daughter, [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], was herself a Jedi, and she forever felt indebted to Piell for his actions in saving her parents. Even after she joined him on the Jedi Council, Gallia sought for a way to repay him, though Piell shrugged off her suggestions, insisting it was all part of his duty.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 1" /> Piell served on the Council during many conflicts, such as the Stark Hyperspace War,<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War 4" /> as one of the Council's senior<ref name="Clone Card: Even Piell" /> and strongest members.<ref name="The Citadel Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab02e35b146012e3aaf648400b4|text=Dataclip: The Citadel|na=video file}}</ref> He was more outspoken than the majority of his peers, and he was characterized by his somewhat radical&mdash;and always direct&mdash;ideas and decisions.<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> During the [[Yinchorri Uprising]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], when many Council members were investigating in the [[Yinchorri system]], the Temple was infiltrated by a group of [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] warriors in a bold attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the Jedi. Wielding his lightsaber, Piell, as well as numerous other Jedi,<ref name="Acts of War 1">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 1|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 1]]</ref> was able to repel the Yinchorri with minimal casualties, though the Council was deeply worried&mdash;it was evident that some unknown entity had guided the Yinchorri into such a foolhardy assault.<ref name="Acts of War 2">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 2|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 2]]</ref> The mission to the Yinchorr [[Star system/Legends|system]] undertaken by Mace Windu and a team of other Jedi was successful, although not without its casualties; Piell attended the triple funeral of fellow Council member [[Micah Giiett]], as well as the Jedi [[Lilit Twoseas]] and [[Theen Fida]].<ref name="Acts of War 4">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 4|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 4]]</ref>

Piell was on the Council during the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] in the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. A team of Jedi led by Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] had been ambushed during a mission to [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]] concurrent with the Summit and had lost contact with Coruscant; the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] terrorist organization claimed to have captured a number of hostages on Asmeru and demanded that the Trade Summit be canceled. Piell advocated stopping the Nebula Front with force, but many of his fellow Council members wished for a more subtle approach. The Lannik also advised offering the houses of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]&mdash;a self-governing domain that existed apart from the Republic and controlled Asmeru&mdash;a deal in exchange for their co-operation; Piell believed that allowing them free trade with the Republic&mdash;something which they had been refused because of their [[Slavery/Legends|slave breeding]]&mdash;for their assistance in bringing the Nebula Front to justice was the best course of action to take. Ultimately, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was able to end the crisis, though not without losing a considerable amount of support in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> Also in 33 BBY, Piell and his fellow Councilors agreed that [[Nuru Kungurama]], a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] youngling found by Jedi Masters [[Ring-Sol Ambase]] and [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], should be accepted into the Jedi Order as an Initiate.<ref name="Guardians of the Chiss Key">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Sith, long thought to be extinct, returned. Qui-Gon Jinn [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|briefly dueled]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|one]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but was able to flee. He told the Council of his encounter, though many of its members were skeptical; nevertheless, Mace Windu agreed to investigate and learn the identity of Jinn's attacker. Jinn had another matter to discuss with the Council: he had found a young boy, named [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who was extremely strong in the Force and whom Jinn believed might be the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]]. Skywalker was brought before the Council, though they deemed him too old and potentially dangerous to be trained. Windu sent Jinn and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in an attempt to lure out the supposed Sith; the plan worked, and Kenobi was able so slay the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], but Jinn perished. Piell and the other members of the Council traveled to Naboo to attend Jinn's funeral. It was the beginning of a dark [[Time/Legends|time]] for the Jedi High Council; one Sith had been slain, but they were unsure if it was the [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] or the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. Skywalker became the Padawan of Obi-Wan Kenobi, though the Council still had doubts about the boy.<ref name="Episode I" />

===Mission to Malastare===
{{Quote|The Red Iaro are weary of fighting. It's time for peace.''"<br />"''The flejj beast also gets tired. But it cannot shed its hide.|Zug and Even Piell|<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" />}}
Later that same year, the conflict between the Red Iaro and the government on Piell's homeworld drew to an apparent close, and Myk'chur Finux Zug declared a stalemate, requesting that the peace process begin. The [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] offered to hold the negotiations on a neutral ground, the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], and the Republic's [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] requested that the Jedi Council send delegates to act as arbiters during the meetings. Adi Gallia, still feeling that she had a debt to repay to Piell, brought the matter up at a meeting of the Council, championing Piell's sacrifice, though he brushed off her comments. As it was a matter of great importance to many systems nearby Lannik, Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] requested that only members of the Council travel to Malastare. Piell volunteered, as his people's ways&mdash;considered somewhat primitive and strange by [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society&mdash;were unknown to the other Jedi, and he felt his presence on Malastare was necessary. Masters [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], Mace Windu, [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]], and Adi Gallia also volunteered to attend the negotiations.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 1" />

Traveling in a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class space cruiser]], the team of Jedi reached Malastare in days, and they were greeted by [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]] and [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Baskol Yeesrim]], who began escorting them to their quarters. The Jedi were suspicious and on guard, as they suspected that the Gran had their own surreptitious reasons for hosting the talks on their adopted homeworld. En route, Piell, Gallia, and Yaddle realized the group was being followed and monitored by a Lannik, whom they presumed was a member of the Red Iaro, and a hooded [[Order of the Ffib|Ffib priest]],<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 2">[[Star Wars (1998) 14|''Star Wars'' (1998) 14]]</ref> a member of a theocratic religion established on the planet [[Lorahns/Legends|Lorahns]];<ref name="FF129">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 129|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 129]]</ref> intrigued, Piell and Gallia doubled back and intercepted the duo, asking why they were following the Jedi Council members. The Lannik and the priest responded by shooting at Piell and Gallia, though the Jedi Masters were able to fend them off with ease, with the help of Ki-Adi-Mundi and his Padawan, [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]], who had just arrived in the corridor. Piell's attackers fled, and the Jedi gave chase but ultimately reached a dead end, where two Gran guards claimed to have seen no beings fleeing in the corridor.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 2" />

[[File:Piell_ETM.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Even Piell and several Jedi during the mission to Malastare]]
Teem and Yeesrim admonished the guards and sent them to look for the assailants before taking the Jedi to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Gujdim Wiphshun]]'s palace, where Teem assured them they would be safe. The Jedi sensed great danger and deception on Malastare, though they put such thoughts to rest when the actual negotiations took place.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 2" /> They were introduced to Wphshun and Senator [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]], the Grans who would chair the meeting; Lannik Prince [[R'cardo Sooflie IX]], the son of the prince whose life Piell had saved several years previously; and Sooflie's military advisor, Piell's old colleague Hutar Zash. Sooflie was suspicious of a countryman serving with what he considered "religious [[ragamuffin]]s," and Piell introduced himself; when Sooflie showed no sign of remembering either Piell or his sacrifice, Gallia admonished him, though the Lannik Prince remarked that had Piell not saved his parents' lives, he might have become prince sooner.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" />

The Red Iaro representatives, led by Myk'chur Finux Zug, eventually arrived, several [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] late, and were immediately dismissive of the Jedi, believing their presence to be unnecessary. Piell confronted Zug, but the Lannik revolutionary claimed that times had changed; the Red Iaro, he said, was tired of fighting and wished to stop. Piell, however, knew that Zug would be back to his old ways before long. Negotiations started, though it was clear to the Jedi that they would go nowhere; Zug's demands were not unreasonable, but Sooflie refused to accept anything, and after an angry outburst from the Prince, Windu called a recess in the talks. Hutar Zash and several other Lannik guardsmen offered to give the Jedi a lift to their quarters in the Governor's palace, and, hoping to use the opportunity to speak to Zash, Piell accepted.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" />

En route, Zash told Piell of matters on Lannik; since Sooflie had ascended to power, the old ways and traditions were dying, and the people were growing more and more unhappy with their new prince. Suddenly, Zash and his subordinates revealed that they had [[thermite charge]]s strapped around their torsos&mdash;they hoped that their sacrifice, performed in front of many [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droids]] recording a [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] on concurrent with the peace talks, would help bring back the old ways on Lannik. Piell reacted extremely quickly, using his lightsaber to bisect the [[EasyRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|EasyRide passenger airspeeder]], leaving himself, Gallia, and Windu on one side and the two Lannik on the other. Zash and his companion's explosives detonated, but the Jedi survived&mdash;however, they were plummeting toward the ground.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" />

They managed to grab a hold of a passing [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], though the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] attempted to knock them off.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" /> Eventually, Windu&mdash;whom Piell and Gallia were holding on to&mdash;lost his grip and fell, though the other airspeeder, piloted by Yaddle, was able to collect them. Presuming that Zug and Zash were in league with each other, the Jedi believed that Zug, with his plan to kill the Jedi a failure, would be desperate, and they concluded that he would attempt to assassinate Sooflie. They arrived in the Prince's chamber as Zug and his minions were preparing to feed Sooflie to a pair of [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]], [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predators native to [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]. Not wanting to kill the creatures, the Jedi subdued them, but Zug was able to use the opportunity to try and escape with a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] through the ceiling [[Window/Legends|window]]&mdash;however, he collided with a podracer, and was killed. Aks Moe and his guards arrived within moments, removing the remaining revolutionaries before the Jedi could question them; the Senator announced the peace talks' end and requested the Jedi return to Coruscant. Sooflie left without showing any sign of gratitude to Piell, though the Jedi Master did not mind&mdash;he knew he had done his duty to the Republic. Piell and his fellow Jedi returned to Coruscant, their mission a complete failure.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 4" />

===Separatist Crisis and Clone Wars===
{{Dialogue|Agen Kolar|It would seem he would have but one trial left to face.|Shaak Ti|Testing the spirit.|Even Piell|Facing the mirror.|attr=The Jedi High Council discusses whether or not to Knight Anakin Skywalker|src=<ref name="CW 21">{{CW|21}}</ref>}}
[[File:Piell_Geonosis.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Piell fighting in the Battle of Geonosis]]
Some time later, Piell took a Padawan learner of his own, a Corellian named [[Jax Pavan]].<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /><ref name="Chee on Piell's Padawan" /> Pavan's father, [[Lorn Pavan|Lorn]], had once been a worker in the Temple, but had been requested to leave after his son was admitted to the ranks of the Jedi Order.<ref name="Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> Piell served on the Jedi Council throughout the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and watched with continuing dismay as more and more systems seceded and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], led by [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku&mdash;a former Jedi.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> However, the CIS was by far not the only threat that the Order, and the Republic, faced. In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], a rogue [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]&mdash;former Jedi Padawan [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]&mdash;killed two Jedi Masters, [[J'Mikel]] and [[Peerce]], on Coruscant, in the shadow of the Temple itself. Piell in particular was shocked by this when it was announced during a Council meeting, and although many efforts were made to apprehend Sing, none succeeded.<ref name="Hunt for Aurra Sing 1">[[Star Wars (1998) 28|''Star Wars'' (1998) 28]]</ref> Following Sing's attack on the Jedi, Piell and the Council attended the ceremony to make Jedi Knight [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] a Jedi Master and Padawan [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] a Knight,<ref name="Rite of Passage 4">[[Star Wars (1998) 45|''Star Wars'' (1998) 45]]</ref> though the Council lost Masters Yaddle and [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]], who both perished defending the Republic from terrorists; they were replaced by the Jedi [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]], respectively.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Piell attended Poof's funeral on Coruscant alongside the Jedi High Council and several [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] Jedi.<ref name="Zam Wesell">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], matters between the Confederacy and the Republic reached a boiling point. Obi-Wan Kenobi, along with Anakin Skywalker and Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], was captured by Separatists on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], and a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|team of Jedi]] led by Mace Windu traveled to the [[Petranaki arena]] on Geonosis to rescue them.<ref name="Episode II" /> Piell was among the 200 Jedi sent and fought in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. Fighting against [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the Petranaki arena,<ref name="The Lesson">{{Tales|14|The Lesson (Star Wars Tales)}}</ref> he was eventually separated from the majority of the Jedi in the arena.<ref name="Geonosis Casualties">{{Blog|holocron|10|Jedi Casualties: Battle of Geonosis}}</ref> The Lannik was one of select few Jedi who survived the battle,<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> with the aid of a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] taken by Yoda to Geonosis. The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had begun.<ref name="Episode II" />

[[File:Even_Piell.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Even Piell on the Jedi Council during the Clone Wars]]
Piell became a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] and participated in a myriad of battles during the three-year conflict,<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> often being assigned vital missions to safeguard vital Republic territory and information.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|evenpiell|Even Piell}}</ref> His [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] came to be [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]],<ref name="The Citadel">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref> who harbored a certain mistrust for Jedi.<ref name="Clone Card: Captain Tarkin">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_captaintarkin.jpg|text=Clone Card: Captain Tarkin|nobackup=1}}</ref> Early in the war, Piell was present during an important Jedi Council meeting, in which the Masters discussed the war. The Separatists' new [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], had recently killed several Jedi during the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]], and the Council was worried about the dwindling numbers of fully-fledged Jedi in the Order. Newly promoted Council member Obi-Wan Kenobi suggested that they make his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, a Knight, though many on the Council disagreed, believing Skywalker too headstrong. Piell pointed out that Supreme Chancellor Palpatine had been campaigning for Skywalker's promotion, though Master Windu replied that [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] had no say in Jedi matters. Ultimately, it was decided that Skywalker would be Knighted, and Piell was present during the ceremony.<ref name="CW 21" />

===Prisoner of the Citadel===
{{Dialogue|Kenobi|Master Piell, are you all right?|Piell|Obi-Wan, what took you guys so long?|Skywalker|At least your sense of humor is still intact.|Piell|It takes more than they got to break me, young Skywalker.|attr=Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker free Even Piell from his containment field|src=<ref name="The Citadel" />}}
[[File:EvenPiellVsSBDs-TC.png|thumb|left|250px|Piell faces off against super battle droids that have boarded his Star Destroyer.]]
On a perilous assignment in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Piell and Tarkin uncovered the coordinates of a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lane]] called the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]], which linked both the Republic and Separatist homeworlds and therefore proved valuable to both sides of the war. When Piell and Tarkin returned from the Outer Rim aboard their [[Even Piell's cruiser/Legends|flagship]], however, the Separatists&mdash;seeking to pilfer the Nexus Route's coordinates from Piell&mdash;mounted an [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|attack]] on his [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] with the intention of capturing him. While a Confederate fleet launched [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] against Piell's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], a battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] boarded the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to capture Piell. To safeguard the information on the Nexus Route, Piell erased his ship's [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and committed half of the information to memory while Tarkin memorized the other half&mdash;that way, in case Piell surrendered the intelligence, it would be useless to the Confederacy without Tarkin's half. It was not long before the battle droid boarding party made it to Piell's position on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the Star Destroyer. Piell at first succeeded in [[Telekinesis/Legends|using]] the Force to destroy the initial group of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], but the appearance of [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] forced him to surrender.<ref name="The Citadel" />

Piell was stripped of his lightsaber, and he, Tarkin, and their crew were taken to the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]],<ref name="The Citadel" /> a reputed Separatist [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfurous]], cracked planet [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]].<ref name="The Citadel Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode318.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Citadel}}</ref> Overseen by the cruel warden [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]],<ref name="Clone Card: Osi Sobeck">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_osisobeck.jpg|text=Clone Card: Osi Sobeck|nobackup=1}}</ref> the prison had been built to hold rogue Jedi and had gained a reputation as a highly impenetrable detention facility. While Tarkin and several [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officers]] were installed in a holding cell, Piell was incarcerated in another cell, where he was held in a [[Containment field/Legends|containment field]]. Under supervision from an [[Unidentified EV-series interrogation droid/Legends|A4 laboratory assistant droid]], a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] [[Torture/Legends|electrocuted]] Piell multiple times with an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] in an attempt to force the Nexus Route intelligence out of him. Piell failed to crack, however, even when the [[A4 laboratory assistant droid/Legends|A4-series]] droid coerced him into yielding the information to put an end to the torture. Just as the droid made to cut out Piell's remaining eye, an elite team of Jedi and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]&mdash;having infiltrated the Citadel under the command of Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi&mdash;broke into Piell's cell. [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] [[Fives/Legends|CT-27-5555]] and [[Echo/Legends|CT-21-0408]]&mdash;nicknamed "Fives" and "Echo," respectively&mdash;shot down the droid [[Commando/Legends|commando]] assaulting Piell and another droid commando in the cell, while [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," took care of the interrogator droid. Kenobi, Skywalker, and the latter's Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], then entered the cell with the rest of the team.<ref name="The Citadel" />

After Kenobi and Skywalker freed him from his containment field and returned his lightsaber to him, Piell told them of his exploits with separating the information on the Nexus Route between himself and Tarkin. The team therefore resolved to free Tarkin and the other officers from their cell. On the way to Tarkin's cell, the Jedi and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] cut through a squad of highly maneuverable droid commandos, though Sobeck&mdash;who was aware of Piell's escape&mdash;had more in store for them. Sobeck activated an ultrasonic wave that impaired the group's hearing, while a powerful [[Magnet/Legends|magnet]] drew the Jedi's lightsabers and the clones' blasters to a raised crevasse in the ceiling. Skywalker was even sucked up to the ceiling by his cybernetic arm, which fell to the magnet's attraction. As the sound frequency died down, droid commandos arrived from both directions of the hallway to subdue the unarmed Jedi and [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. In response, Piell and Tano attempted to Force-push the droids away, while Kenobi pitted his telekinesis against the others. When the droids magnetized their feet to the floor, the three Jedi redoubled their efforts, giving Skywalker enough time to deactivate the magnet holding their lightsabers. Skywalker and the squad's weapons dropped to the floor, and the group made quick work of the droids before continuing on to rescue Tarkin and the naval officers.<ref name="The Citadel" />

[[File:MissiontotheCitadel-The_Citadel.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Piell and the others battle Sobeck's defenses in the Citadel.]]
Once the droid commandos guarding Tarkin and the clones had been destroyed, Piell entered the cell and introduced the others to Tarkin. Although Kenobi and Tarkin debated the best possible method of escaping from the Citadel&mdash;Kenobi favored splitting up to continue separating the Nexus Route information, while Tarkin believed that strength laid in numbers&mdash;Piell chose to go with Kenobi and his squad to create a diversion for Tarkin, Skywalker, Tano, and some of the other clones to escape. The group split up, and Piell and Kenobi led their men through the Citadel, planting [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] as they went. When Kenobi activated the charges, they caused an intense explosion to take the Citadel, compromising one of its entire levels. Thanks to the distraction, Skywalker and his comrades were able to escape from the Citadel. Meanwhile, Kenobi, Piell, and their team headed for the Citadel's upper levels<ref name="The Citadel" /> through a ventilation shaft. Kenobi contacted the Republic's [[Class type B/Legends|stolen Separatist shuttle]], piloted by Skywalker's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and several [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron/Legends|reprogrammed battle droids]]. Kenobi requested a pickup at the Citadel's rear landing platform, only to find out that Skywalker had already given the go-ahead for their departure.<ref name="Counterattack">{{TCW|Counterattack}}</ref>

As Piell, Kenobi, and their men proceeded further upward through the vents, they were spotted by a Confederate [[Separatist probe droid/Legends|probe droid]]. Piell quickly propelled himself into the air, destroying the [[Probe droid/Legends|droid]]. However, security doors started closing throughout the shaft, cutting one clone trooper in half and separating the members of Piell's group from each other. Using their lightsabers, Piell and Kenobi were able to cut their way through the security doors. Emerging from the shaft, Kenobi, Piell, and the clones used ascension cables to reach a lower level near the landing pad. Kenobi tried to raise Skywalker via comlink, but instead they heard Sobeck, who revealed that he had predicted their every move. Upon his words, several hidden turrets on the platform came online, while droid commandos, droidekas, and an [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droid]] emerged, capturing Piell and the others. They were subsequently taken to Sobeck's command center, where the warden demanded that Piell disclose his half of information, threatening to start executing his men if he refused. Piell did not comply, stating that all of them, including the clones, were ready to die to protect the intelligence. Challenging Piell's claims, Sobeck killed one of them with a shot in the head. As he prepared to execute a second trooper, Sobeck was interrupted by his [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], [[K2-B4/Legends|K2-B4]], who informed him that Skywalker's group had been discovered. Sobeck subsequently ordered his droids to take Piell, Kenobi, and the clone troopers to the interrogation center and torture them.<ref name="Counterattack" />

On their way to the prison block, the Republic hostages and their battle droid escorts were intercepted by R2-D2's reprogrammed droids, who assured Sobeck's droids that they would escort the prisoners from that point. Now free, Piell and the others rendezvoused with R2-D2 himself and proceeded toward the landing pad and the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] parked there. Reaching the landing pad, heavily guarded by droids, the Republic team proceeded toward the shuttle, still posing as prisoners under escort from R2-D2's battle droids. The leader of R2-D2's droid team, [[OOM-10/Legends|OOM-10]], tried to bluff his way past several droids guarding the shuttle, telling them that he was taking the prisoners to the fictitious [[Point Tarron/Legends|Point Tarron]]. The lie initially worked and allowed Piell and the others passage toward the shuttle, but they were soon stopped when K2-B4 informed the droid guards about the group's escape&mdash;with assistance from reprogrammed droids. Kenobi destroyed the nearest guard with his lightsaber, but heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] opened fire at the Republic team, forcing them to take cover, while more battle droids arrived at the landing platform. At this moment, Skywalker's group arrived, joining the battle. Tarkin proposed a direct assault on the shuttle, planning to use its weaponry to defeat the droids, but the Jedi were distracted by three droids approaching on [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]].<ref name="Counterattack" />

[[File:PiellDeflect-CA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Piell deflects laser shots from Skywalker's STAP.]]
Leaping onto Skywalker's shoulders and then into the air, Piell dispatched one STAP, while Skywalker took control of another. The third droid followed Skywalker, and Piell hopped onto Skywalker's speeder, deflecting the enemy's shots and dispatching the STAP. Meanwhile, a droid commando attempted to use one of the laser cannons to destroy the Republic shuttle, and trooper Echo informed Skywalker of this. Skywalker and Piell launched an attack run on the droid commando, but the latter shot down their STAP, and the two crashed on the ground. The droid also managed to destroy the shuttle, and Echo was killed trying to protect the craft. With their only means of escape destroyed, Piell and the others retreated from the landing pad. As they were escaping, Kenobi and Skywalker contacted the Jedi Temple, requesting retrieval from the Jedi Council stationed there, and Master Plo Koon promised to send a fleet of cruisers to rescue them. Once they were safely away from the Citadel, Kenobi informed the others that they would have to reach a rendezvous point and hold out long enough to be extracted. However, in order to reach the rendezvous point, they would have to trek across the nearly unnavigable landscape of Lola Sayu.<ref name="Counterattack" />

===Death and legacy===
{{Quote|I have to get help!''"<br />"''No, don't leave. Listen to me carefully, child. The information&hellip;I need you to deliver it back to the Council.''"<br />"''I should find Anakin or Obi-Wan. ''They'' need to hear this.''"<br />"''No, ''you'' must listen.''"<br />"''But I wasn't assigned to the team. I lied, just so I could be a part of the mission.''"<br />"''Whether you were meant to be on this mission or not, you are now the most important part of it. Remember this, and see to it that the information I'm about to give you is revealed to no one but the Jedi Council.|Ahsoka Tano and a dying Even Piell|<ref name="Citadel Rescue" />}}
As the group moved across Lola Sayu's terrain, Kenobi decided to contact the Jedi Council for an update on the Republic forces' estimated time of arrival. Using the [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] built into R2-D2, Piell and Skywalker contacted the Council, talking to Masters Mace Windu and Yoda, who informed them that Koon's battle group was already on its way to Lola Sayu. Yoda and Windu also told them about their rendezvous point with the Republic gunships&mdash;a small island amidst a boiling lake of [[Magma/Legends|lava]]&mdash;and reminded the escapees that they would have only a small window of opportunity for extraction. The group were soon attacked by several droid commandos, but Fives was quick to toss a grenade at a rock base, collapsing it and sealing the way for the droids. Despite the victory, Kenobi was certain that more droids were on the way. As Piell and the others reached a cliff, they were indeed attacked by more droids, including some crab droids. While R2-D2's battle droids delayed the enemy forces, the Jedi and the clone troopers used ascension cables to reach the lower levels, carrying Piell and his officers on their backs; the group suffered more casualties in the descent as a clone trooper and the clone officer he was carrying fell to their deaths when battle droids compromised their cable. After the surviving members of the group reached the ground, they escaped to an underground tunnel to avoid the droids' fire from the cliff.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" />

As the team emerged from the tunnel and avoided an STAP droid patrol, they heard a distant howling. They realized that they would soon be faced with some dangerous predators&mdash;more specifically, a group of [[Anooba/Legends|anoobas]] that Sobeck had released to track them. With the anoobas close behind, the Jedi realized that they would have to battle the creatures, as the creatures would alert the battle droids to their position. To surround the anoobas and better fight them, Skywalker, Kenobi, and R2-D2 continued to move on to serve as a distraction for the creatures to follow. Piell, Tano, Tarkin, and the rest of the team meanwhile waited at a nearby cave for the anoobas to pass, intending to attack the creatures from behind. After Skywalker and Kenobi had begun to battle the anoobas and their accompanying patrol of STAPs, Piell and his group moved in to attack the Separatists from behind. However, they were quickly surrounded by a large number of crab droids. Piell reacted quickly, cutting his way through a crab droid that had been about to kill a clone officer. Ordering Tarkin and the clones to catch up with Skywalker and Kenobi, Piell remained at the cave with Tano to handle the droids, making quick work of most of them. While his attention was focused on destroying one of the last droids, however, Piell was assaulted by one of the anoobas, which knocked him down and mauled him with a mortal wound.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" />

[[File:EvenPiellDying-CR.png|thumb|right|250px|Piell dies in Tano's arms.]]
Seeing this, Tano quickly dealt with the anooba and rushed to Piell's side. She made to get help, but Piell, knowing that he was dying, instructed her to listen and memorize his half of information on the Nexus Route. Tano was hesitant to take such a burden, explaining that she was not even supposed to be on the mission, but Piell assured her that it did not matter anymore&mdash;she was there, and she would now be the mission's most important part. Instructing her to reveal the information only to the Jedi Council, Piell told her all he knew about the route and then passed on. Tano carried Piell's body back to Skywalker and the others, who had defeated Sobeck's forces for the moment. The Jedi draped Piell's body in a cloth and took a brief moment to [[Funeral of Even Piell/Legends|honor]] his sacrifice, [[Cremation/Legends|consigning his body]] to the lava of Lola Sayu. They performed the [[Jedi funeral/Legends|ritual]] quickly, knowing that Piell would have wanted them to complete the mission.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" />

The Republic team successfully reached the island, killed Sobeck, and was extracted by the arriving Republic forces. Upon arrival on Coruscant, however, there was a disagreement between Tano and Tarkin; Skywalker's Padawan intended to deliver her part of information to the Council as she had promised Piell, while Tarkin wanted to share his half directly with Supreme Chancellor Palpatine. Yoda then decided to meet with the Chancellor and choose the best course of action. Piell was greatly missed by the Jedi Council, but his sacrifice was remembered.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Clone Wars ended with the [[Order 66/Legends|near-extermination]] of the Jedi Order and the reformation of the Galactic Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with Palpatine as the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="NEC" /> Piell's species entered a period of great hardship after the Empire blocked the flow of trade to their planet, and, even decades after the Empire was toppled, they were still attempting to restore their economy. Piell was remembered as one of the most famous Lanniks, and his exploits in dealing with the Red Iaro were widely documented.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|[The Nebula Front is] Moving us around like pieces on a hologame board.''"<br />"''Then we need to end the game.|Yoda and Even Piell|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
[[File:EvenPiell-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|Master Even Piell]]
Despite being diminutive in stature, Even Piell was larger than life. Gruff,<ref name="Clone Card: Even Piell" /> outspoken,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> and battle-hardened, he was a great warrior who was noted for his willingness to charge into battle,<ref name="Clone Card: Even Piell" /> as well as for his fearlessness, courage, and tenacity.<ref name="UK Comic 6.18">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.18|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.18]]</ref> He became known as one of the Jedi High Council's senior<ref name="Clone Card: Even Piell" /> and strongest members.<ref name="The Citadel Dataclip" /> During the Red Iaro attack on the Lannik royalty, Piell seemed, to some, hopelessly outnumbered, yet he did not let the odds deter him and emerged victorious. Despite the urgings of many of his peers, he did not attempt to heal his scars; Piell was proud of his achievements, and, to him, his scars represented honor, bravery, and perseverance and reminded him of that day in the Lannik High Court.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" /> Although he had a passion for wisdom<ref name="UK Comic 6.18" /> and was glad to be a scholar on the Council of First Knowledge,<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> he did not let such a position stand in the way of making snap decisions, be it on the Jedi Council or on the battlefield. He believed in diplomacy and negotiations, but he also did not shy away from using force to settle confrontations.<ref name="UK Comic 6.18" />

Piell was extremely loyal to the Jedi, the Republic, and his homeworld. While most Jedi never returned to their planet of origin after being trained in the ways of the Force, Piell was an exception, and to him it was an honor to serve the Lannik royal family, something he took very seriously. He cared deeply for the fate of his homeworld, and it saddened him that some, such as the Gran, seemed to be determined to exploit its untapped natural resources. Piell was known for his considerable wisdom, which he acquired during his long life as a Jedi.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 2" /> However, too many, particularly those on his homeworld who did not understand the ways of the Jedi, he was simply an old man who was too attached to ancient traditions.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" /> He was a traditionalist, teaching his pupils with tested, proven methods; he disapproved of the unorthodox teaching methods favored by many of his peers, such as Master [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]], claiming that they were brutal and disturbing.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 1" /> Piell was opposed to oppression or slavery of any kind, and he voiced his displeasure to the Grans of Malastare that they had subjugated the native Dugs of the world and made them subservient.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 2" /> Despite this, Piell was a proponent of ignoring the Senex [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] stance on slave breeding at the time Eriadu Trade Summit, and allowing them to join the Republic in exchange for their co-operation in apprehending the bounty hunter [[Arwen Cohl]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

Piell was quick-thinking, and when his Star Destroyer was boarded by the Separatists, he cleverly committed half of the information on the Nexus Route to memory while having his Captain, Wilhuff Tarkin, memorize the other half. Piell sometimes disagreed with Tarkin,<ref name="The Citadel" /> who harbored certain doubts about the Jedi and their abilities,<ref name="Clone Card: Captain Tarkin" /> and their relationship was slightly tense at times.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" /><ref name="The Citadel" /> When Tarkin inquired as to what they would do if they did not find the Republic forces at the rendezvous point, Piell brusquely told him to just keep moving, leading Skywalker to advise Tarkin not to try to argue with the diminutive Jedi Master.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" /> Unlike Tarkin, who meant for his half of the information to reach Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's ears, Piell intended for his part of the intelligence to be disclosed only to the Jedi High Council.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" /> While being interrogated in the Citadel, Piell refused to surrender his information on the Nexus Route to a mere interrogator droid.<ref name="The Citadel" /> When faced with Osi Sobeck himself, who threatened to start killing his men if he refused to divulge the information, Piell believed that all of them, including the threatened clones, were prepared to die to protect the information for the Republic.<ref name="Counterattack" />

Although his seriousness made him well-suited to important Council business,<ref name="Mysteries of the Jedi">''[[Star Wars: Mysteries of the Jedi]]''</ref> Piell had a dry sense of humor, developed from his long years spent on the battlefield;<ref name="UK Comic 6.18" /> he joked with Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi even when faced with the daunting prospect of escaping from the Citadel.<ref name="The Citadel" /> He also displayed a certain amount of self-confidence, believing that it would not be a problem for the Republic team to hold out on Lola Sayu until Plo Koon's arrival and that they would easily defeat Sobeck's battle droids.<ref name="Counterattack" /> Even when dying, he was determined to complete the mission at all costs and found within himself the strength to tell Ahsoka Tano the vital information before he died. Despite the fact that Tano had not even been authorized to join the mission, Piell felt that she had become the most important part of the operation, as she was now the person who would ensure, in his place, that the Nexus Route intelligence reached the Jedi Council. Tano viewed Piell's sacrifice as honorable, and the news of his actions struck the Jedi on Coruscant as well, with Mace Windu stating that he would be missed.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Too late, old man! There's nothing you can do to stop us!''"<br />"''Oh, no?|A Lannik terrorist and Even Piell|<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" />}}
[[File:EvenPiell-TCW.png|thumb|right|250px|Even Piell battles crab droids on Lola Sayu.]]
A great warrior<ref name="Clone Card: Even Piell" /> who was no stranger to battle,<ref name="The Citadel Dataclip" /> Even Piell practiced all seven [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber forms]] with equal proficiency, although he did not have a preference for any one of them.<ref name="UK Comic 6.18" /> He was a highly<ref name="Clone Card: Even Piell" /> talented swordsman with his crimson&mdash;later green&mdash;lightsaber, capable of deflecting blaster bolts with ease,<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" /> which he demonstrated during the mission to Malastare<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" /> and his escape from the Citadel.<ref name="Counterattack" /> He even came to be considered one of the Jedi Council's strongest members.<ref name="The Citadel Dataclip" /> Among his natural abilities included his increased audio capacity, as his large ears were sensitive in thin atmospheres.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> He stood up to severe amounts of torture and electrocution, even remaining conscious throughout such bouts. Like all Jedi, however, he was not infallible, and droidekas were able to take him prisoner aboard his cruiser.<ref name="The Citadel" /> Piell was a Jedi Guardian, meaning that he focused more lightsaber combat and also on using the Force in combat than for other means.<ref name="Power of the Jedi" /> He was also a skilled manipulator of the Force; he was able to use it to telekinetically push battle droids away aboard his cruiser<ref name="The Citadel" /> and to propel himself in the air while facing off against numerous battle droids on Lola Sayu. His mastery of the Force on Lola Sayu was well complemented by his agility in combat; he was quite nimble given his size, and he used his nimbleness in conjunction with his use of a lightsaber.<ref name="Counterattack" /> Piell was also rather strong physically and was a skilled pilot.<ref name="UK Comic 6.18" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Even Piell was created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], as one of the non-speaking Jedi during the scenes involving the Jedi Council, though he was debuted in [[Terry Brooks]]' [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Episode I'' novelization]]. In the film, he was portrayed by actress [[Michaela Cottrell]], who wore heavy make-up.<ref name="DB" /> Piell was again featured in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], albeit via stock footage taken during the filming of ''The Phantom Menace'',<ref name="Council Roster">{{Blog|holocron|11|Jedi High Council Roster}}</ref> though he was not seen in the Battle of Geonosis scenes.<ref name="Episode II" /> The character was not featured in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref>

[[File:Piell_Bts.jpg|thumb|left|220px|A mask of Even Piell]]
Piell has had several appearances in subsequent spin off material, mainly as a member of the Jedi Council in [[Star Wars comic books|comics]]. He first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Emissaries to Malastare|''Emissaries to Malastare'']] story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' comic series, which greatly expanded his backstory and character.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare 3" /> He also appeared in numerous other [[Dark Horse Comics]] works, though as a minor character, usually without dialogue,<ref name="Hunt for Aurra Sing 1" /><ref name="Rite of Passage 4" /><ref name="Zam Wesell" /> as well as in [[James Luceno]]'s ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[2001]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> Sources such as the ''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''<ref name="Power of the Jedi" /> and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' established that, although he was not seen in the Geonosis portions of ''Attack of the Clones'', Piell participated in and survived the Battle of Geonosis.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Piell was featured briefly in [[Chapter 21 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|''Clone Wars Chapter 21'']], where he was voiced by [[Daran Norris]].<ref name="CW 21" />

Piell had also appeared in two comics featured in ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'', whose [[canon]]icity is uncertain. Piell appears on the Jedi Council in "[[Yaddle's Tale: The One Below]]";<ref name="Yaddle's Tale">{{Tales|5|Yaddle's Tale: The One Below}}</ref> the story has since been referenced by ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'',<ref name="FF 105">{{FactFile|105|YAD 1-2|Yaddle}}</ref> though Piell's part in the tale has yet to be referenced by a canon source. As Oppo Rancisis, later revealed to be Yaddle's Padawan in the ''Power of the Jedi Sourcebook'', is present on the Council when Yaddle is inducted to that body, it can be assumed that at least some of the Councilors featured in it are not canon.<ref name="Yaddle's Tale" /> Piell also makes a brief appearance in "[[The Lesson (Star Wars Tales)|The Lesson]]," which portrays him fighting during the Battle of Geonosis.<ref name="The Lesson" /> Piell's role in the comic was canonized in [[Leland Chee]]'s blog,<ref name="Geonosis Casualties" /> though the canonicity of the comic as a whole is uncertain.

===Fate under debate===
{{Quote|We never fully explained who Anakin replaced when Palpatine appointed him to the Council and so we just went off the assumption that it was Piell who got the short shrift. So when we went looking for a prominent Jedi to kill off early on in Coruscant Nights, Even Piell fit the bill. It wasn't until after the Coruscant Nights trilogy was completed that we learned that Even Piell's death would be rewritten with this episode.|Leland Chee, in response to Piell's depicted death in "Citadel Rescue"|<ref name="Chee on Citadel Rescue">{{Blog|holocron|54|Citadel Rescue Episode Guide}}</ref>}}
[[File:EvenPiellFuneral-CR.png|thumb|right|250px|Piell's funeral on Lola Sayu in "Citadel Rescue"]]
Piell's absence in ''Revenge of the Sith'' left his fate unexplained,<ref name="Episode III" /> and it was not known if he had survived Order 66 or not until author [[Michael Reaves]] featured him in the opening chapters of his [[2008]] novel, ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''.<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> However, this was to be [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] several years later in [[February]] [[2011]], when Piell made his debut in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Chee on Citadel Rescue" /> Voiced by voice actor [[Blair Bess]], Piell appeared in a [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] story arc comprised of the episodes "[[The Citadel (episode)|The Citadel]],"<ref name="The Citadel Ep Guide" /> "[[Counterattack]],"<ref name="Counterattack Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode319.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Counterattack}}</ref> and "[[Citadel Rescue]]." The latter episode overturned the canonicity of ''Jedi Twilight'' by depicting Piell's death on Lola Sayu, chronologically prior to his original death in the novel during Order 66.<ref name="Citadel Rescue Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode320.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Citadel Rescue}}</ref> According to Leland Chee, who clarified the major change in continuity, Piell had been chosen to die in ''Jedi Twilight'' because he was a prominent Jedi, though he had not in fact made an appearance in ''Episode III''.<ref name="Chee on Citadel Rescue" />

The following section lists the events of ''Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight'', which can no longer be regarded as canonical with the newer version of Piell's death in "Citadel Rescue." Although the novel depicted the Corellian Jax Pavan as Piell's Padawan,<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> Leland Chee initially stated that with the premiere of "Citadel Rescue," Piell was no longer considered to be Pavan's Master.<ref name="Chee on Citadel Rescue" /> However, this was revised and clarified with the release of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.18|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.18]]'' publication;<ref name="UK Comic 6.18" /> Chee stated that Piell was in fact still assumed to be Pavan's Master, at least at one point in time.<ref name="Chee on Piell's Padawan" /> Specific parts of ''Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight'' were never retconned. Chee indicated that staff at [[Lucasfilm]] discussed the idea of making modifications to future reprints of the novel,<ref name="Chee on Facebook">{{Facebook|username=people/Star-Wars-Books/100064411132431|url=starwarsbooks/posts/10151104645258713?comment_id=23597084&offset=150&total_comments=216|name=[[Leland Chee]]|date=2012-08-14|quote=The Clone Wars version of events always take precedent. At one point, we actually discussed whether we change CN I in the reprint.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/oyRE8}}</ref> though they ultimately decided against it.<ref name="No Reprint">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=470551479632450&id=201820953172172&comment_id=20218597&offset=0&total_comments=20|name=[[Leland Chee]]|date=2012-09-29|quote=I've discussed elsewhere that at one point we'd considered making changes to the Coruscant Nights reprint but ultimately decided against it. I'm always open to possibilities that our authors suggest for continuity band-aids when discrepancies, however big or small, occur. In the meantime, when we refer to this material in future titles, we'll probably just leave out specific names.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/zicQq}}</ref>

====''Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight''====
{{Quote|Don't talk; you need to save your strength. I'll call a medic, and they'll fix you right&mdash;''"<br />"''Oh, don't be an idiot. Move me and I'll come apart like a holopuzzle. I'm done&mdash;we both know it. Someone must take over my mission. Now pay attention&hellip;|Nick Rostu and Even Piell|<ref name="Jedi Twilight" />}}
During his training of Jax Pavan, Piell taught Pavan that Jedi did not need the Force to exist; even without it, their ideals and dogma still made them Jedi. Pavan found this particular lesson difficult to comprehend, even years later. Piell, who became almost like a father to his Padawan, took Pavan on many assignments, including two into the deepest level of Coruscant's undercity. Pavan was knighted two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the war's end in 19 BBY;<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> by this point, Piell, now quite old,<ref name="NEGTC" /> was no longer a member of the Jedi High Council, and his vacant seat was taken by Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="Episode III" /> Piell was present in the Jedi Temple when Order 66 and [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] were initiated. Hordes of clone troopers, led by Anakin Skywalker&mdash;who had become the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, freshly turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&mdash;assaulted the Temple, mercilessly killing Jedi, [[Temple employee|employees]], and younglings, while across the galaxy, clone troopers turned on their generals and executed them. Piell fled the Temple, finding his way into Coruscant's underlevels and hiding there. He believed that he was the only senior Council member to survive the slaughter,<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> though several other Councilors did in fact survive.<ref name="NEC" /> In the days that followed, Palpatine issued the [[Declaration of a New Order]], becoming Galactic Emperor, and the remaining Jedi [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|were hunted down]] one by one by Darth Vader and many other dark side underlings. Piell knew his days were numbered, and for the first time in his life, he knew fear.<ref name="Jedi Twilight" />

Piell survived for [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]; while many of his fellow survivors stopped using the Force in an attempt to avoid detection, he refused to sever his ties to the Jedi Order and continued to utilize the Force. He did, however, avoid using it in public, though he generally lived in ghettos and slums in the [[Crimson Corridor]], where he could avoid detection. Some time after Operation: Knightfall, Piell learned of a droid, designated [[10-4TO|4-TO]], that held considerable amounts of secret information of a sensitive nature about the Empire. According to his sources, Darth Vader was attempting to hunt down the droid, and Piell made it his mission to locate it, believing he would save many lives in doing so.<ref name="Jedi Twilight" />

[[File:JediCouncil1-NEGTC.png|thumb|left|220px|Even Piell, alongside several of his fellow Jedi]]
Several months after the Great Jedi Purge had begun, Piell was somehow located by the Empire, and teams of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] pursued him in Coruscant's deepest slums. [[Force sense/Legends|Sensing]] them through the Force, he attempted to hide in what was once a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] den, but in doing so, he had allowed himself to be cornered. Piell tried to escape via a tube, through which an elevator once traveled, though he had to use the Force in order to push himself upwards. The stormtroopers entered the building just as he entered the tube, and began firing at it; too late, Piell realized their tactics. They fired above and below where he was, melting the tube and fusing the two sides together to create an impassable mass, leaving Piell trapped. Using his lightsaber, he was able to free himself from the tube, though he was still effectively trapped; the five troopers had blocked the only exit, and Piell knew that his weeks on the run, with little food or rest, had left him far from peak fighting condition.<ref name="Jedi Twilight" />

Piell deflected everything the Imperials fired at him, but he was unable to escape. Knowing it was a risky tactic which the stormtroopers might have witnessed before, he [[Force jump/Legends|Force Jumped]] over the troopers and towards the exit, and his attempt was almost successful. However, one of the troopers detonated a [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash grenade]], leaving Piell temporarily blind, while the troopers' helmets made them immune to the grenade's effects. Piell was still able to use the Force to deflect blaster bolts and make his way toward the door, but again, the clones were one step ahead of him. One of them threw an impact sensitive grenade toward him, while another fired at it, detonating the explosive less than a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] away from Piell and injuring him severely. Piell realized that he had been outwitted, before releasing a horrified scream.<ref name="Jedi Twilight" />

The stormtroopers never got the chance to finish off the Jedi Master, as a group of [[Whiplash]] rebels ambushed them from the other side of the exit, injuring several of them and forcing the troopers to flee. Piell recognized one of the rebels as [[Nick Rostu]], a friend of the Jedi Order, and beckoned him to listen to his final request. Despite Rostu's comments, the Lannik Jedi knew he would die within minutes; he told Rostu about 4-TO and his mission, asking him to locate Jax Pavan&mdash;who Piell knew was still alive&mdash;and have him complete the mission. Rostu agreed, and Piell died.<ref name="Jedi Twilight" />

Rostu informed Pavan, who had already sensed his Master's death, about Piell's mission, and with the help of several others, Pavan located and tracked down the droid. Ultimately, 4-TO had been a ruse by Darth Vader; hoping to lure out Pavan for his own clandestine reasons, he had purposely allowed Piell to learn about the droid's supposed "secrets"&mdash;which were in fact non-existent&mdash;knowing he would assign the mission to Pavan. Pavan discovered this, but he refused to forget what Master Piell had taught him and continued to live as a Jedi.<ref name="Jedi Twilight" />

===Non-canon storyline===
After the airing of ''The Clone Wars'' episodes featuring Piell and the change in his biography they created, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.20|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.20]]'' presented an alternative, [[Infinities]], scenario to the events from those episodes which would have unfolded if Skywalker and Kenobi had failed to rescue Piell from the Citadel because they had collided with a rogue hyperspace shadow while en-route to Lola Sayu. The shadow sends their shuttle off-course from Lola Sayu and deactivates R2-D2 and his droids. Without R2-D2 to release them from [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], in which they froze themselves to pass the Citadel's [[Life-form scanner/Legends|lifeform sensors]], Kenobi, Skywalker, and their men remain in hibernation for nearly twenty years. In the meantime, Sobeck successfully extracts the information regarding the Nexus Route from Piell and Tarkin. With the coordinates of the Nexus Route now in their hands, the Confederacy launches a surprise attack on Coruscant, forcing Palpatine&mdash;who is secretly leading the Confederacy as the Sith Lord Darth Sidious&mdash;to "negotiate" a surrender with Dooku that places Palpatine at the throne as the Galactic Emperor. Nearly twenty years later, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], the leader of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], finds the drifting Republic shuttle and unfreezes Kenobi, Skywalker, and the others, who join the fight against the Empire.<ref name="TCW UK 6.20">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.20|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.20]]</ref>
